title: Set-generated cocomplete preaisles of derived module sheaves
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a small site and $R$ a sheaf of rings on it, with module-sheaf category $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Work in the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], in one fixed universe. Let $S$ be a set of objects of $D(\mathcal A)$. Let $\mathcal U$ be the smallest strictly full subcategory containing $S$ and zero and closed under small coproducts, direct summands, the shift $[1]$, and extensions (if $A\to B\to C\to A[1]$ is distinguished and $A,C\in\mathcal U$, then $B\in\mathcal U$). Put $\mathcal U^\perp=\{B:\operatorname{Hom}(A,B)=0\text{ for every }A\in\mathcal U\}$. Then every $K\in D(\mathcal A)$ admits a distinguished triangle $A\to K\to B\to A[1]$ with $A\in\mathcal U$ and $B\in\mathcal U^\perp$. Equivalently, $(\mathcal U,\mathcal U^\perp[1])$ is a t-structure [def-weil-t-structure]. Moreover $B\in\mathcal U^\perp$ if and only if $\operatorname{Hom}(G[k],B)=0$ for all $G\in S$ and all integers $k\geq0$.
